description:
Problem. #2797 pinned the SHA-256 of https://dev.meta.ai/install.sh in the four "Install muse" steps of .github/workflows/oracle-review-shadow.yml (`MUSE_INSTALLER_SHA256`, checked with `test "$(sha256sum ...)" = ...`). That file is only a bootstrap. It downloads https://api.meta.ai/muse-launcher.sh, checked only against an `x-content-sha256` header from the same server and skipped when the header is absent. The launcher then reads the `muse-stable` channel and downloads whatever binary version is current from lookaside.facebook.com, checked against a hash in the same publisher's release manifest. muse releases about daily, so the code that runs is not pinned, and the 2026-10-07 plan's "download a fixed version" cannot be met through the installer (the launcher accepts only a channel). The pin has a silent failure mode: if Meta edits install.sh, every muse install step fails and muse is recorded as not installed until someone updates the hash, with no alert. docs/operations/oracle-review-v2.md still says muse is "installed unpinned", which is closer to the truth than the pin suggests.

Decision (owner, 2026-10-09). Run the latest muse from the `muse-stable` channel on every run. Remove the hash pin. Do not pin a binary version, and do not set `MUSE_NO_AUTO_UPDATE`: each GitHub-hosted runner starts clean, so every run already installs the current release, and the launcher's background update check cannot affect the muse process already running.

Required change.
- Remove `MUSE_INSTALLER_SHA256` and its check from all four install steps. Keep the HTTPS-only download (`curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2`) to a file under `$RUNNER_TEMP`, then `bash` it.
- Record the installed muse version in each muse attempt (for example `muse --version` after install, shown in the job summary and the attempt's diagnostic), so each verdict can be traced to a release.
- Docs: rewrite the muse sentence in docs/operations/oracle-review-v2.md (Setup, `META_API_KEY` bullet) to say muse runs the latest `muse-stable` release, unpinned, what is exposed (the `META_API_KEY` secret and a read-only checkout of a public repository), and that the owner accepted this on 2026-10-05 and reconfirmed it on 2026-10-09. Add a dated note to _project/decisions/oracle-review-v2-shadow-2026-10-05.md recording that the installer hash pin was tried and removed, and why.

Out of scope. Muse subscription auth (`MUSE_AUTH_PATH`), the model choice, the reviewer order, `MUSE_CHANNEL` (stay on `muse-stable`).

Guardrails.
- The workflow is a soundness path and very-high tier; the change needs an oracle success review.
- Do not change the claude or codex install pins.
- Worktree via `make worktree-create` and `make agent-write-preflight`; identity Joe Harris <joeharris76@gmail.com>; explicit staging; `make comment-policy-check`.

Decision gate. None remaining.
